proposals.citation: CDIAL[12803-3 and addenda];pattanaik-koul2003varli[p. 83, item 207, Dungar Varli]
proposals.evidence: Turner section3 groups Marathi sahā/sā and Konkani sa under *kṣaṭ or *kṣvaṭ. The survey sɔ is assigned to this regional plain-s series, retaining its rounded vowel; superficial vowel similarity to the northwestern ṣo series does not establish the separate *ṣuvaṭ branch. This is a regional family inference, not an exact Turner attestation of sɔ. Existing manual-page-image source audit has no reading uncertainty. Davar/Bhili and Dungar/Varli labels are preserved; no specific recent donor is established.
